utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still ready to help—what’s the most urgent thing you need for the repair drive right now?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Tools and basic supplies are the biggest gap right now—what can you bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo — I’ll send over the locations I have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — once you send them, I’ll update the list and line up volunteers and tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Uli — I’ll help spread the word and see if I can round up some nails, tarps, tape, and a few working tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Mara — that would help a lot. Those basics are exactly what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I’m happy to help keep the repair drive moving. What still needs to be gathered?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Start with the leaky sink and the front door hinge—they’re the most urgent. I’m still making the list of what else we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s keep it simple: could you check for nails, tape, tarps, and any working tools first? If we know those basics, I can sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — I’ll check for nails, tape, tarps, and any working tools first, then I can sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Start with the leaky sink and the front door hinge—I’ll check what we’ve got for those first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks—Sunday at the community center, and the biggest help we need is sorting tools and greeting folks at check-in. Start with the sink and hinge if you can, and I’ll keep the volunteers pointed that way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over my tool kit. Just let me know what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what part of the repair drive needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think they said tape and sturdy boxes are still useful, but I may be mixing that up a bit. If you’ve got either, just take it over and they can use help with the urgent stuff too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s coming together nicely—people’ve been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re swinging by, a roll of tape or a sturdy box would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear — I’ll resend the repair drive details so everyone has the latest info, and I’ll note tape or a sturdy box as helpful extras.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — send me the latest repair drive details and I’ll spread the invite right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send you a clear list of the locations and priorities next, so the repair drive stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We still need the biggest gaps filled—Pia’s been sending the priority list, and I’m sorting what comes in. If you’ve got supplies, I can point you to the spot that needs them most.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the leaky sink and front door hinge are still the top priorities, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — if you can keep checking for nails, tarps, tape, and working tools, I’ll keep the rest of the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — send me the locations as you find them, and I’ll keep the repair drive list straight.
